tasks.en:
Spain is one of the most popular tourist destinations in the south-west of Europe. It is famous for its beaches, bullfights and festivals.

Spaniards are famous for their beauty. They have Mediterranean features, which means that they have got black hair, brown eyes and dark skin, and they are not very tall. They are lively, friendly and very sociable people.

In Spain, most people live in cities in small flats. They work in offices, shops and factories.

The Spanish love to eat seafood and omelettes. They usually have a light breakfast and a big lunch late in the afternoon.

In their free time, Spaniards love going to cafes and clubs, and going out for dinner with friends and family.

Spain is a fantastic country to visit. Its warm climate and passionate people make it a great place for a holiday.

tasks.en:
Dear Anna,

My name is Dilshod. I am fourteen years old and I live in Tashkent, Uzbekistan.

There are five of us in our family: my parents, my two brothers and me. My father is a doctor and my mother is a teacher. We live in a flat near the city centre.

My school is about one kilometre from our house, so I always walk. I usually leave home at half past seven and lessons finish at one o'clock. When I get home, I have lunch and do my homework. In the evening I watch TV or play football with my friends.

At the weekends, we often visit my grandparents in the countryside.

Well, that's all about me. Please write back soon.
Best wishes,
Dilshod

tasks.en:
The Waterfall

One morning Dan and Mark pushed their canoe into the river. The sun was shining and the water was calm. "Where's the map?" Mark asked. "I think I left it in the car," Dan said. "Never mind, we'll be fine."

Later, they stopped to have a cup of hot coffee. While they were drinking, they watched a beautiful kingfisher on a branch. They didn't notice that the river was getting faster.

A short while later they decided to turn around. "Oh, no! A waterfall!" Dan shouted. The current was very strong and they couldn't paddle back. The canoe was moving faster and faster towards the waterfall.

"Here! Catch!" someone shouted. Two fishermen on the river bank threw them a rope. Dan caught it and the fishermen pulled the canoe to safety. "Thank you! You saved our lives!" the boys said. Next time, they will remember to take the map.

sentencePatterns.formula: X is one of the most popular [ot] in [joy].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Spain is one of the most popular tourist destinations in Europe.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ispaniya - Yevropadagi eng mashhur sayyohlik manzillaridan biri.

sentencePatterns.formula: X is famous for its [nima].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It is famous for its beaches, bullfights and festivals.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U plyajlari, buqa janglari va festivallari bilan mashhur.

sentencePatterns.formula: In their free time, [xalq] love + -ING.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: In their free time, Spaniards love going to cafes.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bo'sh vaqtida ispanlar kafega borishni yaxshi ko'radi.

sentencePatterns.formula: There are [son] of us in our family: ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There are four of us in our family: my parents, my sister and me.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Oilamizda to'rt kishimiz: ota-onam, singlim va men.

sentencePatterns.formula: It takes [vaqt] to + FE'L.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It takes nearly an hour to get there.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U yerga yetib borish deyarli bir soat oladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: I usually leave home at [vaqt] and get to school at [vaqt].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I usually leave home at twenty past eight and get to school at twenty to nine.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Odatda uydan sakkiz yigirmada chiqaman va maktabga to'qqizga yigirma qolganda yetib boraman.

sentencePatterns.formula: I always go by + TRANSPORT.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I always go by bike.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Men har doim velosipedda boraman.

sentencePatterns.formula: I lost my [buyum] on [reys/poyezd] from [joy] to [joy] on [sana].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I lost my suitcase on flight DLT456 from New York to Heathrow on 5th August.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Men 5-avgust kuni Nyu-Yorkdan Heathrowga DLT456 reysida jomadonimni yo'qotdim.

sentencePatterns.formula: It is a [o'lcham] [shakl] [rang] [buyum]. It is made of [material].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It is a large rectangular blue suitcase. It is made of plastic.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu katta to'rtburchak ko'k jomadon. U plastikdan yasalgan.

sentencePatterns.formula: Inside, there are/is [nima].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Inside, there are some clothes, shoes and a camera.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ichida kiyimlar, poyabzal va kamera bor.

sentencePatterns.formula: Please contact me on [raqam] [qachon].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Please contact me on (0171) 6274731 after 6 pm any day.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Iltimos, har kuni soat 18:00 dan keyin (0171) 6274731 raqamiga qo'ng'iroq qiling.

sentencePatterns.formula: X was + -ING when suddenly + PAST SIMPLE.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He was skiing alone when suddenly one of his skis hit something hard.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U yolg'iz chang'i uchayotganda to'satdan chang'ilaridan biri qattiq narsaga urildi.

sentencePatterns.formula: X tried to + FE'L, but + GAP.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He tried to stand up, but he had broken his leg.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U turishga harakat qildi, lekin oyog'i singan edi.

sentencePatterns.formula: X began to feel + SIFAT.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Jack began to feel frightened.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Jack qo'rqa boshladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Thanks to X, I didn't + FE'L.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Thanks to that dog, I didn't freeze to death.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: O'sha it tufayli muzlab o'lmadim.

sentencePatterns.formula: One morning + EGA + PAST SIMPLE.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: One morning Dan and Mark pushed their canoe into the river.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bir kuni ertalab Dan va Mark kanoelarini daryoga surdi.

sentencePatterns.formula: "...!" + EGA + shouted/asked/said.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: "Oh, no! A waterfall!" Dan shouted.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: "Voy, yo'q! Sharshara!" - qichqirdi Dan.

sentencePatterns.formula: While they were + -ING, they + PAST SIMPLE.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: While they were drinking, they watched a kingfisher.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ichayotganlarida ular zarg'aldoqni tomosha qilishdi.

sentencePatterns.formula: X was moving faster and faster towards Y.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The canoe was moving faster and faster towards the waterfall.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kanoe sharshara tomon tobora tez harakatlanardi.

sentencePatterns.formula: I was glad to hear that + GAP.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I was glad to hear that you are going on holiday to Toronto.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Torontoga ta'tilga ketayotganingni eshitib xursand bo'ldim.

sentencePatterns.formula: I'm going to + FE'L because I want to + FE'L.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I'm going to take driving lessons because I want to buy a car.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Haydash darslarini olmoqchiman, chunki mashina sotib olmoqchiman.

sentencePatterns.formula: I can't afford + OT.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I can't afford a holiday this year.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu yil ta'tilga pulim yetmaydi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Do + FE'L! (kuchaytirish)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Do send me a postcard from Toronto.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Torontodan albatta otkritka yubor.

sentencePatterns.formula: You shouldn't eat too many/much + OT because ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: You shouldn't eat too many biscuits because they are bad for your teeth.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Juda ko'p pechenye yemasligingiz kerak, chunki ular tishingiz uchun zararli.

sentencePatterns.formula: You should eat/drink a lot of + OT because ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: You should drink a lot of water because it keeps your body healthy.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ko'p suv ichishingiz kerak, chunki u tanangizni sog'lom saqlaydi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Don't + FE'L + too much/many ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Don't drink too much coffee.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Juda ko'p qahva ichmang.

sentencePatterns.formula: We have already + V3 + OT.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: We have already painted the walls.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Biz devorlarni allaqachon bo'yadik.

sentencePatterns.formula: We haven't + V3 + OT + yet.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: We haven't bought all the furniture yet.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Biz hali barcha mebelni sotib olmadik.

sentencePatterns.formula: I'm sorry I haven't + V3 + for so long.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I'm sorry I haven't written for so long.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Shuncha vaqt yozmaganim uchun kechir.

sentencePatterns.formula: I've been very busy since + PAST SIMPLE.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I've been very busy since we moved into our new house.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Yangi uyga ko'chganimizdan beri juda band bo'ldim.

sentencePatterns.formula: X is one of the greatest [kasb] in the history of [soha].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Martina Hingis is one of the greatest tennis players in the history of women's tennis.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Martina Hingis - ayollar tennisi tarixidagi eng buyuk tennischilardan biri.

sentencePatterns.formula: X was born in [joy] on [sana].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Martina was born in Kosice on 30th September, 1980.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Martina 1980 yil 30-sentyabrda Kosice shahrida tug'ilgan.

sentencePatterns.formula: In [yil], at the age of [yosh], X won ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: In 1996, at the age of 15, she won the Wimbledon doubles title.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: 1996 yilda, 15 yoshida, u Wimbledon juftlik unvonini yutdi.

sentencePatterns.formula: When X retires, she'd like to + FE'L.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: When she retires from tennis, she'd like to keep horses.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Tennisdan nafaqaga chiqqanda u ot boqishni xohlaydi.

sentencePatterns.formula: When I came home, I found that X had + V3.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: When I came home, I found there had been a burglary.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Uyga kelganimda o'g'irlik bo'lganini topdim.

sentencePatterns.formula: The burglars had + V3 + OT.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The burglars had broken the window and opened the safe.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: O'g'rilar derazani sindirib, seyfni ochgan edi.

sentencePatterns.formula: I'm having + OT + V3 (soon).
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I'm having a burglar alarm installed soon.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Tez orada o'g'ri signalizatsiyasi o'rnattiraman.

sentencePatterns.formula: As I'm sure you can imagine, + GAP.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: As I'm sure you can imagine, I was very shocked.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Tasavvur qilganingdek, juda hayratda edim.

sentencePatterns.formula: X was designed by [kim] and was completed in [qachon].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It was designed by Bonnano Pisano and was completed in the 14th century.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U Bonnano Pisano tomonidan loyihalangan va 14-asrda tugallangan.

sentencePatterns.formula: X is made of [material].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It is made of white marble.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U oq marmardan qurilgan.

sentencePatterns.formula: X was built as [maqsad].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It was built as a memorial to Napoleon's battles.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U Napoleon janglari yodgorligi sifatida qurilgan.

sentencePatterns.formula: Today X is visited by [kim].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Today it is visited by millions of tourists.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bugun uni millionlab sayyohlar ziyorat qiladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: We're staying in a [sifat] [joy] near/with [nima].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: We're staying in a cosy wooden chalet near the ski slopes.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Biz chang'i qiyaliklari yonidagi shinam yog'och shalede turibmiz.

sentencePatterns.formula: The weather is [sifat], but/and we + FE'L every day.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The weather is freezing cold, but we go skiing every day.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ob-havo muzday sovuq, lekin har kuni chang'i uchamiz.

sentencePatterns.formula: You must come here one day!
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: You must come here one day!
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bir kun bu yerga kelishing kerak!
